label: Мы
description: First-person plural sentences focused on shared action, shared objects, and collective agreement.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared motion. 'Мы' makes the subject plural and collective, and 'идём' takes the first-person plural ending to match. 'Домой' is the directional adverb naming the destination.
Strategic focus: Group action. 'Читаем' is the first-person plural present, and 'книгу' is the accusative direct object. 'Вместе' underlines the collective sense of 'мы'.

Strategic focus: Plural subject with two objects. 'Пишем' is the plural form, 'письмо' is the accusative direct object, and 'нашему другу' is the dative recipient. The sentence layers agreement and case.
Strategic focus: Collective perception. 'Видим' is the plural present form, and 'море' is the accusative object. 'Отсюда' anchors the viewpoint and makes the line natural.

missions.phrase: Мы очень любим этот старый дом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared evaluation. 'Любим' is the correct plural present form, and 'этот старый дом' is a masculine accusative phrase with agreeing modifiers. The line practices plural emotion and agreement together.

missions.phrase: По утрам мы едим хлеб с сыром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Irregular verb in the plural. 'Едим' is the plural form of the irregular 'есть', distinct from 'я ем' and 'ты ешь'. 'Хлеб' is the accusative object and 'с сыром' adds an instrumental phrase.

missions.phrase: После прогулки мы пьём холодную воду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Shared survival need. 'Пьём' is the first-person plural present, and 'холодную воду' is a feminine accusative phrase. 'После прогулки' sets a natural time frame in the genitive.

missions.phrase: Извините, мы вас совсем не понимаем.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negation with a group subject. 'Не' negates the verb 'понимаем', which is the proper plural first-person form, and 'вас' is the accusative object. This is a key phrase for travel and class.
Strategic focus: Shared desire. 'Хотим' is the plural first-person form, and 'кофе' is an indeclinable everyday noun. 'Пожалуйста' makes the request polite and natural.
Strategic focus: Group activity with location. 'Работаем' is the plural present form, and 'из дома' is a source phrase in the genitive. 'Сегодня' grounds the action in time.
Strategic focus: Collective language identity. 'Говорим' is the plural form, and 'по-русски' names the language of speech. 'Только' sharpens the claim, making it natural group speech.
Strategic focus: Group knowledge. 'Знаем' is the first-person plural form, and 'этого человека' is an animate masculine accusative phrase. 'Прекрасно' adds a natural degree of certainty.

Strategic focus: Plural object handling. 'Берём' is the plural form of 'брать', and 'такси' is an indeclinable object. 'До вокзала' adds a genitive destination, making the line sound like real travel speech.
Strategic focus: Shared physical action. 'Открываем' is the plural present form, and 'все окна' is a plural accusative object. 'Утром' sets a routine time frame in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Plural perception. 'Слушаем' is the plural first-person form, and 'тихую музыку' is a feminine accusative phrase with an agreeing adjective. 'Вечером' sets the scene naturally.
Strategic focus: Pronoun object form. 'Видим' is plural first person, and 'тебя' is the accusative form of 'ты'. The line reinforces how a pronoun changes when it leaves subject position.
Strategic focus: Routine collective action. 'Делаем' is a common plural present form, and 'зарядку' is the feminine accusative object. 'Каждое утро' adds a habitual time frame.
Strategic focus: Carrying as a group. 'Несём' is the plural present form, and 'тяжёлую сумку' is a feminine accusative phrase. 'Вместе' stresses the shared effort behind 'мы'.
Strategic focus: Group discovery. 'Находим' is the plural form of 'находить', and 'нужный ключ' is a masculine accusative phrase. 'Наконец' adds the satisfaction of finally finding it.

missions.phrase: Сейчас мы думаем только о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Collective thought plus case control. 'Думаем' is the plural first-person form, and 'о работе' shows the prepositional case after 'о'. The verb shapes the case of what follows it.
